description:
Every stored Polymarket market of one event_slug: the moneyline, spreads, totals, team totals, half and quarter lines, player props and the rest, plus the markets of the event's child events (a soccer game's exact score, halftime result and more-markets events), each with its own event_slug. Each row carries the condition_id, the provider's sports_market_type and groupItemTitle, the provider's typed line and, when stated, the outcome index it belongs to, both outcome labels with their CLOB token ids, active or closed status, and settlement: how Polymarket's oracle settled or is settling the market (status observed, not_posed or unavailable; oracle_status, the provider lifecycle state such as proposed, disputed or resolved; settled; payouts, micro-USDC per share per outcome index; result outcome or split, the 50-50; winning_outcome_index; was_disputed; resolved_at; expected_settlement_time and settlement_time_basis; proposed_answer for a pending round; observed_at; a null is unknown). Ordered by sports_market_type, then line, then condition_id. Pass a condition_id to get_market_holders, get_market_flow or get_market_snapshot.

Args:
  - event_slug (string, required): the event slug from list_games, get_game or a search_markets result, for example nba-bos-orl-2026-11-01. Matched case-insensitively. Live, upcoming and settled events all answer
  - sports_market_type (string, optional): comma-separated provider market types to keep, case-insensitive (spreads, totals, points, first_half_totals). Omitted keeps every type; an unknown type returns an empty page
  - status (string, optional): active, closed or all (default all)
  - limit (number, 1-100, default 20)
  - cursor (string, optional): opaque gmk_v1_ cursor from next_cursor, sent with the same filters
  - expand (string[], optional): sharp_money adds each row's sharp_money: status (computed, not_computed or unavailable; the first read of a game can be unavailable while its split is built, so retry after a few seconds), trader_count, per-outcome usd and S/A/B wallet counts, and money_as_of, the game page's per-line split. quotes adds each outcome's quote, the figures get_market_snapshot reads, for the whole page in one cache read and on every plan: status (observed; no_orderbook when the provider confirmed the outcome has no book; unavailable when nothing is cached yet, every figure null: the read starts covering the page's open markets, so read again after a few seconds), price (0 to 1, the price Polymarket shows) with price_basis (midpoint when the best bid and ask are at most $0.10 apart, else last_trade) and price_observed_at, best_bid and best_ask with book_observed_at, and book_unavailable_reason (null with a book; else cache_miss, no_orderbook, missing_provider_token_id, or stream_capacity: API reads already hold every live book they may open, so reading again does not help until fewer markets are read). A null figure is one the cache does not hold, but a null best_bid or best_ask beside book_observed_at is a side with no orders. It adds 1 to the cost. trading_terms adds each row's trading_terms from the market's Gamma record, on every plan: status (observed; not_listed when Gamma's market list returns no record for it; unavailable when no read is in hand yet, every figure null: read again after a few seconds), fees_enabled, fee_schedule (rate, exponent, taker_only and rebate_rate, the fraction of taker fees rebated to the resting maker), rewards_min_size (shares), rewards_max_spread (cents from the midpoint), reward_allocations (rewards_amount, rewards_daily_rate, start_date, end_date), seconds_delay (seconds before a newly placed marketable order can match) and tick_size, with observed_at. Every figure is Polymarket's, never derived. It adds 1 to the cost

Returns: data, has_more, next_cursor, event_slug, families and meta. families lists every market type the event holds with its market and active counts, whatever the filters: read it first to choose a sports_market_type. A slug no stored market carries answers 404; an event outside sports and esports answers 404 with reason market_out_of_scope. Carries a price only with expand quotes, and no holder identity: get_game_holders reads the holders of several of these markets in one call.

cursor.description: Opaque gmk_v1_ cursor from next_cursor, used with the same filters

event_slug.description: The game's event slug, for example nba-bos-orl-2026-11-01; matched case-insensitively

expand.description: sharp_money adds each row's sharp-money split: side USD and S/A/B wallet counts per outcome (#32155). quotes adds each outcome's quote: the cached display price, best bid and best ask, each with its observation time (#32893). trading_terms adds each row's fee schedule, reward settings, order delay and tick from its Gamma record, with its observation time (#32688)

sports_market_type.description: Comma-separated provider market types to keep, case-insensitive: spreads, totals, points, first_half_totals. Omitted keeps every type; the response's families lists the event's types

status.description: Keep only active or only closed markets; default all

name: list_game_markets
title: List a game's markets
